help.name: list_markers
help.help: List the markers available to --markers and exit.

help.name: list_tests
help.help: List what the names and --markers select, by project, module and class, and exit. With --lab, lists only the projects active for that lab; contacts no host.

help.name: markers
help.help: pytest -m marker expression applied after collection. Narrows the named tests, or selects on its own when no name is given.

help.name: random_order
help.help: Shuffle test order (pytest-randomly). On by default; the seed is logged at session start. --no-random runs tests in source order.

help.name: seed
help.help: Fix the random-order seed (the value a previous run logged). Implies --random.

help.name: iterations
help.help: Repeat each test N times within a single setup/teardown cycle (0 = disabled).

help.name: duration
help.help: Repeat tests for N seconds within a single setup/teardown cycle (0 = disabled).

help.name: threshold
help.help: Minimum per-test pass rate percentage required in stability mode (0-100).

help.name: results
help.help: Write test results (JUnit XML) to PATH (default: auto in log dir).

help.name: cov
help.help: Collect coverage from the lab's instrumented products after the run finishes. Default: auto — on when a product built with coverage counters is detected and \[coverage] is configured. --cov forces it on (an error if nothing is instrumented); --no-cov forces it off.

help.name: cov_dir
help.help: Run directory to stage coverage in: writes PATH/cov, which `otto cov report PATH` reads. Implies --cov. Default: the run's own output dir, so coverage lands in <output_dir>/cov.

help.name: overwrite_cov_dir
help.help: Allow a non-empty PATH/cov (it is cleared before the run; the rest of PATH is kept).

help.name: cov_clean
help.help: Delete .gcda files on remote hosts before the test run.

help.name: cov_report
help.help: Generate an HTML coverage report after the run finishes. Implies --cov. Default location: <output_dir>/cov_report.

help.name: cov_report_dir
help.help: Directory to write the HTML coverage report to. Implies --cov-report (and --cov). Default when --cov-report is used alone: <output_dir>/cov_report.

help.name: overwrite_cov_report_dir
help.help: Allow --cov-report-dir to target an existing non-empty directory (its contents will be cleared before the report is rendered).

help.name: report_title
help.help: Title shown in the HTML report header (only used with --cov-report).

help.name: cov_tickets_json
help.help: Also write a machine-readable per-ticket coverage summary to this path. Implies --cov-report. Requires \[coverage.tickets] to be configured (checked before the test run starts).

help.name: monitor
help.help: Collect host performance metrics for the entire test run.

help.name: monitor_output
help.help: Override the destination for monitor data. Format inferred from suffix (.json or .db). Implies --monitor. Default: <output_dir>/monitor.json.

help.name: monitor_hosts
help.help: Regex matched against whole host IDs (fullmatch) to restrict --monitor: 'sensor' does not select 'sensor-1' — write 'sensor.*'. Implies --monitor.

help.name: ensure
help.help: Converge: check state first, recover a partial install.

help.name: recover_partial
help.help: With --ensure: uninstall a PARTIAL lab before installing fresh.
